vendors.name: Munchies
vendors.summary: Roti wraps, toasties and hand-cut waffle fries — organic, coconut-oil-fried comfort food to fuel the dancefloor.
bio: Munchies brings roti wraps built around flame-grilled chicken or golden chickpea falafel, piled with fresh vegetables and finished with creamy tahini or shawarma sauce.
Alongside the wraps: fully-loaded toasties in combinations like bacon and egg, tomato and cheese, or bacon and cheese, plus organic hand-cut waffle fries fried in coconut oil.
Prices run from R10 to R120, with a chickpea falafel option for vegetarians.

vendors.name: Groove Gear
vendors.summary: A festival lifestyle lounge for LED and UV accessories, face and body gems, hair braiding, glow transformations and relaxing massage.
bio: Groove Gear is a festival lifestyle brand created from a love for music, creativity, self-expression and the festival community, bringing the magic of festivals to life through LED and UV accessories, festival fashion, face and body gems, festival makeup, hair braiding, creative glow transformations and relaxing festival massage experiences.
The Groove Gear Lounge offers festival-goers a space to express themselves, recharge, connect and add extra sparkle, colour and energy to their Earthdance experience.

vendors.name: Mushmore
vendors.summary: A non-alcoholic wellness bar for whatever mood you're in — uplift and energise, replenish and revitalise, or wind down and socialise.
bio: Mushmore is a wellness bar serving non-alcoholic, adaptogen and nootropic based beverages. Whether you want to uplift and energise, replenish and revitalise, or wind down and socialise, there's a variety of mocktails, lattes, coffees and canned beverages crafted for your needs — and so mush more.
The lineup runs through wellness brands like Almmy sparkling teas, Numuti social tonics, Vitafuel and Teelixir, with vegan, sugar-free options throughout.
vendors.logo_alt: Mushmore logo — the wordmark MUSH MORE in gold, with a sunburst in place of the O in More

vendors.name: Lekker Leaf Wellness
vendors.summary: Cannabis and wellness body goods — "where community grows one leaf at a time."
bio: Lekker Leaf is a holistic health and wellness business dedicated to creating a nurturing space for change, healing, and growth. We believe in a well-rounded approach to wellness, combining the wisdom of natural remedies, traditional medicine, and modern wellness practices.
Our mission is to guide individuals toward balanced and sustainable well-being, rooted in connection to both the self and nature.
Their tagline says it best: where community grows one leaf at a time.

vendors.name: GeoVinty Clothing
vendors.summary: A celebration of sacred geometry, creativity and individuality — each garment upcycled with bleach into a unique piece of wearable art.
bio: GeoVinty Clothing is a celebration of sacred geometry, creativity and individuality. Each garment is upcycled with bleach into a unique piece of wearable art, made with love and positivity.

No two pieces are ever exactly the same, making every creation as individual as the person wearing it. Inspired by free-spirited expression and festival culture, GeoVinty is all about wearing something meaningful, sustainable and beautifully different.
Wear your vibe.

bio: Chai'la serves a zero-proof bar built around chai tea, Chinese tea and cacao.
Dairy-free options are available across the menu.

vendors.name: Fresh Bean Coffee Company
vendors.summary: Espresso-based coffee, matcha, fresh juices and boba, plus milkshakes, slushes and dirty sodas.
bio: Fresh Bean Coffee Company's menu runs from espresso-based coffee and hot chocolate to freshly squeezed juices, milkshakes, slushes, dirty sodas and frezos, with matcha and boba on offer alongside the coffee.

vendors.name: Love Pizza
vendors.summary: A family-run wood-fired pizza institution at Cape Town festivals since 2009 — part of the Earthdance family for over a decade.
bio: Love Pizza has been bringing great pizza to Cape Town's best festivals and events since 2009. A family-run business by Lisa (foodie extraordinaire) and Prince (operator like no other), they've also been part of the Earthdance family of food vendors for well over a decade.

They make their own large pizza bases, use top-quality toppings and offer a delicious selection of classic, gourmet, vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. Every pizza is cooked in their traditional wood-fired oven for that perfect crisp, flame-kissed crust and smoky flavour.

The menu runs from a classic Margherita through Hawaiian, Rosa (cherry tomato, feta and basil pesto), Daisy (chicken, feta and peppadews), Trio (bacon, feta and mushrooms), S.O.S (salami, olives and sundried tomatoes) and Carni (bacon, ham, chicken and salami). Every pizza is a large, built to satisfy a hungry festival-goer solo or split between friends.
Sharing is caring. Be nice, share a slice.

vendors.name: Oh So Peachy
vendors.summary: Delicious food and raw juices made with love — pancakes, samosas, cold-pressed juices and heartier plates.
bio: Oh So Peachy is a food trailer cafe serving pancakes (plain or filled), samosas, smoothies and raw juices, plus heartier plates like stir-fry, Thai curry and wraps.

The raw juice menu includes Green Machine (celery, cucumber, apple), Apple Home (apple, ginger, lemon), Beetroot Energy (beetroot, carrot, apple, ginger) and Golden Love (turmeric, apple, orange, lemon, ginger, cayenne pepper) — fresh ingredients, made with love, supporting local.

vendors.name: Atma
vendors.summary: Vegan and vegetarian food with close on 20 years on the festival circuit — curries, roti, samosas, sweets and now barista coffee too.
bio: Atma has been serving vegan and vegetarian meals at festivals and events around South Africa for close on 20 years. The stall is run and owned by husband-and-wife team Rupa and Shyama, who have both been immersed in vegetarian and yoga culture for most of their lives.

On the menu: healthy, wholesome vegan and vegetarian food — vegetable curries, basmati rice, dhal, roti, samosas, spring rolls and toasted sandwiches, plus freshly made raw juice and smoothies, and traditional sweets like burfi and their famous chickpea fudge.
Atma also roasts its own micro-batch, air-roasted coffee beans, with the full range of barista coffees on offer — cappuccino, latte and more.

vendors.name: Rosa Divina Adornment
vendors.summary: Intentional handmade adornment — handwoven talismans and ritual wear devoted to radiance, sovereignty and self-empowerment.
bio: Rosa Divina (formerly Autumn Essence Creations) is intentional handmade adornment devoted to the reclamation of your highest self.

We offer timeless handwoven talismans and ritual wear that invite you to embody your radiance, sovereignty and innate power. We believe adornment is not separate from self-empowerment — what we choose to wear can become a reflection of what we are ready to embody.

Each talisman is handcrafted with ethically sourced gemstones, and our clothing collection is handmade with natural, sustainable or recycled fabrics. Our adornment honours the Divine Feminine within us all.

vendors.name: Chill and Charge
vendors.summary: A relaxed space to power up your phone — and yourself — between sets.
bio: Chill and Charge is a laid-back space where, while you wait for your technology to charge, you can chill, chat, network or just be you.
Once your technology is charged, you too will be recharged, rejuvenated and ready to party on. Charging available by the half hour.

vendors.name: Wild & Woven
vendors.summary: For the wanderers, the wild ones, the barefoot dancers and the beautifully unconventional — 100% natural-fibre handmade clothing.
bio: For the wanderers, the wild ones, the barefoot dancers and the beautifully unconventional.

Wild & Woven brings 100% natural-fibre handmade clothing, with a love for earthy textures, relaxed fits, playful prints and pieces that are made to move with you — clothes for wherever the adventure takes you.

vendors.name: Blissful Wellness Escape
vendors.summary: The ultimate wellness escape — massage, henna art, hair braiding and a glitter bar. Close your eyes, take a breath, restore, glow.
bio: Blissful Wellness Escape brings the ultimate wellness escape to the festival — because even festival warriors need a little time to pause, breathe and recharge.

On offer: blissful massage, back, neck and shoulder treatments, foot and calf revival, manicures and pedicures, beautiful henna art, hair braiding and a glitter bar. Whether you're dancing all day, exploring the festival or simply need a moment to yourself, come escape and experience Earthdance like never before.
vendors.logo_alt: Blissful Wellness Escape logo — a watercolour spa illustration with candles, lotus and lavender, above the wordmark and the tagline Where inner peace meets outer glow

vendors.name: Afrikan Crown
vendors.summary: Rasta clothing and accessories — trance dresses, reggae tees and vests, and smoking accessories.
bio: Afrikan Crown brings Rasta-inspired clothing to the market village: flowing trance dresses, reggae-print tees and vests, tie-dye and embroidered tunics carrying icons like Bob Marley and Haile Selassie.
Alongside the clothing rail sits a full spread of Rasta items and smoking accessories — rolling papers, grinders, pipes and bongs in every colour.

vendors.name: Firehawk Ink
vendors.summary: Tattoos — take a piece of Earthdance home under your skin.
bio: Firehawk Ink offers tattoos on site — a lasting way to mark the weekend.

vendors.name: Earth Stories
vendors.summary: Handcrafted sterling silver and gold-plated jewellery paired with consciously curated natural clothing, each piece telling its own story.
bio: Earth Stories Cape Town is a slow-fashion, artisan brand built around handcrafted jewellery and consciously curated natural clothing. Pieces are made from sterling silver and gold-plated metal, often finished with ethically sourced elements like protea pods, brass and silver — delicate, story-infused designs meant to spark self-expression.

The clothing range runs alongside the jewellery, cut from breathable, sustainable cotton and rayon. Both are inspired by the raw beauty of Cape Town, with a thread of harmony, self-expression and mindful living running through the whole collection. Earth Stories is a regular at conscious markets and wellness gatherings across the Cape, from Spiritfest to Earthdance.
